name: wasm_agent_compose
description: Compose an RVF container with explicit skills, MCP tool descriptors, prompts, and tools. Returns base64-encoded RVF bytes + a manifest of what was packed. SECURITY: mcpTools accepts only an explicit allowlist — never pass "*". Destructive tools (memory_delete, *_shutdown, federation_*, etc.) require mcpToolsAllowDestructive: true. Use includePlugins to auto-wire skills from plugins that declare rvagent.exposeSkillsAsTools.

includePlugins.description: Plugin names whose rvagent.exposeSkillsAsTools skills should be included

mcpTools.description: Explicit allowlist of MCP tool names to embed (principle of least privilege)

mcpToolsAllowDestructive.description: Set true to allow destructive tools (*_delete, *_shutdown, federation_*, etc.)

name.description: Optional name for the composed agent
